headline: Midwestern State beat St. Mary's again and stay unbeaten
dek: Midwestern State beat St. Mary's at home on Saturday, as they had on the same ground in conference play. They have won fifteen and drawn five this season without a loss, conceding fifteen goals, and remain the only side in the conference yet to be beaten.
displaced_by: The match the standing headline looked ahead to was played: Midwestern State beat St. Mary's on Saturday.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fourteen different players have scored Midwestern State's 53 goals, and Parker Plaxco has seventeen of them.

wire.line: Every side but Midwestern State has now lost at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian have lost four times, and St. Mary's are the only conference side to have beaten them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have lost twice, against eleven wins and seven draws, and conceded sixteen goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all sixteen of their matches and scored twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 78 saves for Sul Ross State.

last_match.line: Midwestern State have now beaten St. Mary's twice on this ground, and have yet to lose this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
